result.topic_en: A page of numerical tables: two columns of decimal values indexed 0 to 19, where each pair sums to about 1229.9 or 1229.8 (or to a constant near 1564/1230 in later rows), plus faint pencil columns and a few large numbers in the margin.

methods.what: Table of complementary values: each pair in a row sums to a constant (≈1229.9 for rows 0–6 and 15–19), giving the second column as the constant minus the first
Column of large integers listed in the margin, possibly successive differences or remainders
